hero.title: Services
hero.subtitle: From concept to deployment — I offer end-to-end solutions tailored to your business needs.

services.title: Full Stack Web Development
services.description: Custom web applications built from the ground up using modern frameworks. Responsive front-ends paired with robust, scalable back-end APIs — designed for performance and maintainability.

services.title: DevSecOps Consulting
services.description: Security woven into every stage of your development pipeline. I help teams shift left by integrating automated scanning, policy-as-code, and secure architecture patterns from day one.

services.title: Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure
services.description: Scalable, cost-efficient cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Infrastructure as Code ensures your environments are reproducible, version-controlled, and audit-ready.

services.title: CI/CD Pipeline Design
services.description: Automated build, test, and deployment pipelines that get your code to production faster and safer. From GitHub Actions to GitLab CI — I design workflows that teams actually enjoy using.

services.title: Security Audits & Penetration Testing
services.description: Comprehensive security assessments of your applications and infrastructure. I identify vulnerabilities, provide actionable remediation steps, and help you build a stronger security posture.

services.title: Technical Consulting & Mentoring
services.description: Strategic guidance for teams looking to level up their engineering practices. Whether it's adopting IaC, improving code review culture, or upskilling on security — I meet you where you are.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: We discuss your goals, challenges, and requirements to define a clear project scope.

process.title: Proposal
process.description: I deliver a detailed plan with timelines, milestones, and transparent pricing — no surprises.

process.title: Build
process.description: Development begins with regular check-ins, demos, and iterative feedback loops.

process.title: Deliver
process.description: Thorough testing, handover documentation, and post-launch support to ensure everything runs smoothly.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.text: Let's talk about your project and see how I can help.
